body.x: With the support from Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, LITTLEONE (CEO Lee Byeong-gyu) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its IoT device for parenting activity monitor Smart Bottle.
Smart Bottles are Bluetooth and IoT devices that keeps the milk temperature right, helping nursing parents struggle with feeding for smart parenting.

This product keeps the optimum milk temperature when connected to the power to feed the baby at the desired time. By integrating the feeding angle detection technology and air inhaling prevention monitoring technology, improper feeding position can be corrected.

As it is a product used by a child, it goes through strict inspection. It is safe with FDA-certified medical-level silicone and the glass made with the safest material for food container. Detailed data related to child care can be recorded by connecting with a smartphone through Bluetooth communication installed in the product.

Daegu Metropolitan City has supported 196 ICT venture companies and SMEs in the area to enter the market for eight consecutive years since 2013, with the cumulative contract amount of $22.4 million as of 2019.

Daegu Joint Pavilion, organized by Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, will have 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
